name: arch-pushover
title: Shoebuckle arch — pushover to lambda=1
teaches: A 2-D fiber-section beam-column frame built through g.model.geometry (columns + a circular arch), pushed under a parametrised inward pressure field declared through g.loads and read back into the OpenSees deck via an explicit ops.pattern.Plain(...).from_model(...) import; a LoadControl ramp to lambda=1 with limit-point handling, MPCO recording, and Results.from_mpco() read-back including results.assess().

metrics.name: lambda_final
metrics.note: LoadControl + Linear timeSeries(factor=1): domain pseudo-time == load factor lambda.

metrics.name: crown_disp_x_mm
metrics.note: Measured 2026-08-17 with the opensees_env interpreter; amendment approximation was 3.36.

metrics.name: u_vs_diag
metrics.note: RES.U_VS_DIAG from results.assess() — |u|_max / model_diagonal. Measured 2026-08-17; amendment approximation was 5.3e-4.
